what: Decided as the brain to raise the producer deadline from 1800 s to 3000 s (job 20261025-150509-dmwc): six producer runs since 2026-10-24 hit the deadline and lost their work, including the keep-work-on-timeout job itself.
why: A timeout costs the whole run; a longer deadline costs time only on runs that need it. Splitting jobs, a faster suite and keeping work on timeout remain queued.
